From the earlier attempt: a 11 December 2025 press release has Himes praising 'encouraging the development and implementation of artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and other emerging technologies' (promotion, D; left out); the 20 October 2026 election letter text says AI offerings carry 'substantial benefits and substantial risks' about election misinformation (D); the himes.house.gov site search for 'superintelligence' returned nothing; Himes is not among the 12 cosponsors of H.R. 10538. His 7 February 2025 Intelligence Committee opening remarks PDF could not be read as text and was not checked. The TRAPS quote is the middle of a longer sentence ('Scammers have always been ... but AI-powered voice cloning ... to swindle Americans – especially seniors – out of their hard-earned money').
